name: Assassins
description: Ghosts and killers who murder for coin or cause.

typeUpgrades.name: Assassin Rigging
typeUpgrades.description: You get 2 free load in two of the equipment categories (weapons, implements, supplies, gear, documents, and tools).

typeUpgrades.name: Ironhook Contacts
typeUpgrades.description: Your Tier is effectively +1 higher in prison.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Skulks
typeUpgrades.description: Your Skulks cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Elite Thugs
typeUpgrades.description: Your Thugs cohorts get +1d to quality rolls for related actions.

typeUpgrades.name: Hardened
typeUpgrades.description: Each PC gets +1 trauma box. Costs three upgrades to unlock, not just one.

features.name: Deadly
features.description: Each PC may add +1 action rating to Hunt, Prowl, or Skirmish (up to a max rating of 3).

features.name: Crow's Veil
features.description: You don't take extra heat when killing is involved on a score.

features.name: Emberdeath
features.description: Take 3 stress to destroy a victim's spirit and body at the moment you kill them (electroplasmic disintegration).

features.name: No Traces
features.description: When you keep an operation quiet or make it look like an accident, you get half the rep value of the target (round up) instead of zero. When you end downtime with zero heat, take +1 rep.

features.name: Patron
features.description: When you advance your Tier, it costs half the coin it normally would. Who is your patron? Why do they help you?

features.name: Predators
features.description: When you use a stealth or deception plan to commit murder, take +1d to the engagement roll.

features.name: Vipers
features.description: Take +1 result level when acquiring or crafting poisons. You are immune to your own poisons when you employ them.

features.name: Veteran
features.description: Choose a special ability from another source.
